speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned presenting with gait and limb ataxia; please tell me specifically how these symptoms have progressed over time and if they are associated with any other neurological issues like weakness, numbness, or vision changes. Additionally, could you describe your significant medical history in detail?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like a significant imbalance; does this clumsiness on the right side affect your ability to perform daily tasks, and have you noticed any difficulty speaking or swallowing? Also, when did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

I have identified your history of Crohn's disease and treatment with natalizumab, which is a known risk factor for PML. Given your gait and limb ataxia, I need to confirm the presence of visual symptoms or recent cognitive changes to complete the assessment.
